latest_release.name: v0.6.0
latest_release.body:
Adds Ethernet tethering, a DNS setting, and Russian, Turkish and Simplified Chinese translations, and keeps a session running when its helper or Shizuku stops. Thanks to [@salasxchristian](https://github.com/salasxchristian) for the ping and UDP fixes in [#74](https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/pull/74) and [#75](https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/pull/75), [@SHAREN](https://github.com/SHAREN) for the Russian translation and the string extraction behind every translation in [#60](https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/pull/60), [@7tg](https://github.com/7tg) for the Turkish translation in [#68](https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/pull/68), and [@LimAimo](https://github.com/LimAimo) for the Simplified Chinese strings reused from [#45](https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/pull/45).

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/blob/v0.6.0/CHANGELOG.md) for the full list of changes.

## What's Changed
* feat: recover sessions when the helper or Shizuku stops by @carlelieser in https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/pull/77
* fix(datapath): answer IPv4 pings from tethered clients by @salasxchristian in https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/pull/74
* fix(datapath): use one outside UDP port per client port by @salasxchristian in https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/pull/75
* feat: add localization infrastructure by @carlelieser in https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/pull/78
* feat: add Russian translation by @SHAREN in https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/pull/60
* feat: add Turkish translation by @7tg in https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/pull/68
* docs: add security policy by @carlelieser in https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/pull/81
* Add 32-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a) build by @carlelieser in https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/pull/82
* docs: note split tunneling hides the VPN by @carlelieser in https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/pull/88
* fix: stop active downstreams before starting by @carlelieser in https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/pull/84
* feat: add Simplified Chinese translation by @carlelieser in https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/pull/89
* feat: Ethernet tethering and wired tethering setting by @carlelieser in https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/pull/90
* fix: update Simplified Chinese strings for wired tethering by @carlelieser in https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/pull/92
* fix: exit the helper when Shizuku stops it by @carlelieser in https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/pull/91
* fix: retry hotspot with 2.4 GHz allowed when saved band is refused by @carlelieser in https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/pull/93
* feat: use the VPN's DNS or custom servers for tethered clients by @carlelieser in https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/pull/94
* chore: release 0.6.0 by @carlelieser in https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/pull/95

## New Contributors
* @salasxchristian made their first contribution in https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/pull/74
* @SHAREN made their first contribution in https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/pull/60
* @7tg made their first contribution in https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/pull/68

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/compare/v0.5.0...v0.6.0

detail.readme:
Shizzi

Wi-Fi, USB, and Ethernet tethering over a Shizuku-privileged test network.

Creates a test TUN interface, sets it as the preferred tethering upstream, and forwards hotspot traffic through a Go datapath. Supports IPv4 and IPv6. ## Requirements - Android 11 (API 30+), 64-bit or 32-bit ARM (arm64-v8a or armeabi-v7a) - [Shizuku](https://shizuku.rikka.app/) 13.6.0+ Android 13 and up work outright. On Android 11 and 12 it depends on the device's tethering module; the app checks on first launch and offers to install the module it needs. That module is 64-bit only, so a 32-bit device needs Android 13. See [compatibility](docs/android-compatibility.md). ## Install Download the APK from the [latest release](https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/releases/latest). ## Features - 🚀 **Unlimited hotspot.** Sharing draws on your regular data instead of your hotspot allowance. - 🛡️ **VPN compatible.** Stay private on every connected device. - ⚙️ **Uses your existing hotspot.** No extra configuration required. - 🔌 **Wired tethering.** Share over a USB cable to a computer, or over a USB-C Ethernet adapter, alongside or instead of the hotspot. Pick it under Settings → Tethering → Wired tethering; turn off Wi-Fi hotspot there to share over the cable only. See [Ethernet tethering](docs/android-compatibility.md#ethernet-tethering) for what an adapter needs. - 🙌 **No root.** Shizuku is all it needs. - 🎛️ **One tap away.** A quick settings tile starts and stops sharing from the notification shade. - 🤖 **Automatable.** Start and stop from Tasker or MacroDroid. See [automation](docs/automation.md). ## Troubleshooting **Shizuku stops when the hotspot or wired tethering turns on.** If you start Shizuku with Wireless Debugging, a network change can turn Wireless Debugging off and take Shizuku with it. Sharing resumes once Shizuku is started again. Starting Shizuku with root, or over adb in TCP mode, avoids the problem. **Connected devices bypass the VPN, or sharing won't start with VPN set to Always.** Shizzi only sees a VPN that covers every app. If your VPN app has per-app proxy or split tunneling turned on (v2rayNG and AmneziaVPN, for example), Shizzi cannot detect the VPN. Turn that setting off in the VPN app. ## Build Needs the Android SDK with NDK, Go, and gomobile: ``` go install golang.org/x/mobile/cmd/gomobile@latest && gomobile init ./gradlew assembleDebug ``` ## License [MIT](LICENSE)
